fields.label: Active
fields.description: Unticking retires this step without deleting it or the history of coaches who already completed it - it just stops being created for anyone newly starting onboarding.

fields.label: Hidden From Coach
fields.description: An HQ-only task the coach never sees on their own onboarding page at all - not even as a locked/greyed-out row. Still shows in the franchisor drill-down so HQ can track and complete it.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.description: Who this step is provisioned for. "Both" is one shared step - edit it once here and it's current for coaches and session workers alike. Every step that existed before this field was added defaults to "Coach" (its only previous behaviour), so nothing already live changes just because this field exists.

fields.label: Stage Sort Order
fields.description: Stages are displayed in this order (ascending) - stage name alone doesn't sort correctly (e.g. "Stage 10" would sort before "Stage 2").

fields.label: Where It Happens
fields.description: e.g. LMS, Frappe, External, In-Person, Manual, Background

fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: Where the "Go" action on this step should send the coach - an LMS course, a document to sign, etc. Leave blank for a step with no specific destination.

fields.label: LMS Course
fields.description: Pick by course Title. Once LMS Course and LMS Chapter are both set, the Go link and Done status for this step are worked out automatically from the coach's actual progress through that chapter's lessons, instead of using Link URL / needing anyone to mark it done by hand.

fields.label: LMS Chapter
fields.description: The specific chapter within LMS Course (its name already reads as its title, e.g. "0001 Access your emails with Chantelle Venter").

fields.label: LMS Lesson Number
fields.description: Which lesson within the chapter Go should open (its position in the chapter's lesson list, not the lesson's own name) - Done still requires every lesson in the chapter, not just this one.

fields.label: Legal Record Type
fields.description: Only used when Where It Happens is exactly "Legal Record" - one of profile.py's LEGAL_RECORD_CONFIG keys (e.g. "safeguarding_certificate", "dbs", "identification"), not a raw fieldname - the matching child table on Coach/Session Worker is resolved per role from there, since it isn't always spelled the same way on both (e.g. DBS Update Service). This step is marked Done automatically the moment that table has a row with its file attached - never by Mark Done, and never locked by Depends On regardless of what that's set to.

fields.label: Depends On
fields.description: Optional - if set, this step shows as locked for a coach until the step it depends on is marked Done.
